html:
Experience a luxurious 5-star cruise with Vietlook Travel, visitors will experience swimming pools right on the cruise, especially families with young children who love to play on cruises at sea.

Especially for women, the swimming pool is not only a place for entertainment, but also a luxurious check-in point, saving beautiful photos, so experiencing a Halong cruise with a swimming pool is the most popular choice for visitors.

Experience the Elite of the Sea cruise, a gold-plated swimming pool, visitors will experience a large 6-star cruise, on the cruise there is a Cigar club, a gold-plated infinity pool, a shopping area, a mini golf course, a European-style restaurant.

The swimming pool on the Elite of the Sea cruise is one of the large swimming pools located right at the end of the 2nd floor, a very large swimming pool and right next to the bar with sun loungers, from here visitors can admire the scenery on the bay.

Elite of the Sea Cruise has 35 rooms, a gym, spa, conference room and restaurant serving meals throughout the tour. In addition, when experiencing the cruise, visitors can also participate in fishing, diving, kayaking and visit famous landmarks.

Capella Cruise

Capella meets 5-star standards, and is fully equipped with luxurious amenities to take visitors to explore the beauty of Ha Long, especially interesting games such as: water slide, swimming pool, Cigar & Poker club, Gym, Karaoke, MiniGolf, Lounge and a balcony overlooking the bay.

When experiencing the Ha Long Capella Cruise, visitors will participate in interesting games such as: water slide, swimming pool, Cigar & Poker club, Gym, Karaoke, MiniGolf, Lounge … or kayaking, swimming will bring visitors the most perfect vacation in Ha Long.

Stellar of the Sea Cruise

On the cruise, there is a 4-season swimming pool located on the 3rd floor of the cruise, and you will be served drinks. When soaking in the pool, visitors will feel the beautiful natural scenery.

Heritage Cruise

On the cruise, visitors will experience the swimming pool on the 2nd floor, and right at the bow of the ship is a beautiful check-in point. The swimming pool is decorated with LED lights and sun loungers for visitors to sit and admire the scenery on the bay.

Ambassador Cruise

The 5-star cruise includes 46 rooms, with a large space for visitors to freely check in beautifully. On the cruise, there is a swimming pool located right at the stern of the 3rd floor. Next to the swimming pool, there are sun loungers and chairs for visitors to sit and admire the scenery on the bay.

Essence Grand Cruise

Essence Grand meets 5-star standards, with full luxury amenities, the boat has a swimming pool located on the 2nd floor at the stern of the cruise, from the cruise visitors can admire the beautiful panoramic view of the sea and islands.

In addition, when participating in the Essence Grand cruise, visitors not only experience the swimming pool but also participate in services such as gym, spa, conference room, bar, luxury dining area serving dishes throughout the trip, will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation in Ha Long.

So to admire that beauty with your own eyes, visitors should travel with Vietlook to Ha Long tour today, experience Ha Long cruise and soak in the cool water right on the cruise, participate in interesting games, enjoy Asian and European dishes throughout the tour.
